title: HowlForge Availability State
description: Runtime availability as observed by whoever runs the workers. HowlForge only ever reads this file; HowlPlane and HowlRelay write it. That division is deliberate, so HowlForge can never be the component that trips a rate limit while checking for one.

state.description: AVAILABLE, DEGRADED and UNKNOWN are usable. A capacity condition (BUSY, SESSION_LIMIT, QUOTA_LIMIT, RATE_LIMIT) is expected to clear; a fault (AUTH_FAILURE, WORKER_FAILURE) is not.

reset_at.description: When a capacity condition is expected to clear. Honored only for capacity conditions; a fault carrying one never reports as eligible after reset.
